sentences.text: This video can not be played The zeptoverse explained by BBC science correspondent Pallab Ghosh Scientists have picked up signals from the smallest scale of nature ever explored – 100 billion times smaller than an atom.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: A world so small that some physicists have nicknamed it the zeptoverse.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: The research, led by scientists based in Cambridge, was obtained from an experiment at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC).
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: This vast machine at the European Laboratory for Particle Physics (Cern) on the Swiss-French border smashes atoms together to break them apart and discover what is inside them.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: The result is important because it could help researchers develop a new, more complete theory of how the Universe works.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Many sub-atomic particles are created by smashing the insides of atoms together Dark matter makes up a large part of our cosmos, and yet researchers have struggled to detect it.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Scientists know it is there because its gravitational force influences normal matter, but in all other respects it has remained completely invisible.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: So in this experiment, particles were smashed together at high energy and scientists studied the material that was thrown out - the shrapnel of collisions.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: One of these is a sub-atomic particle - smaller than an atom - called a beauty quark.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: The particle is unstable and exists for just one and a half trillionths of a second before breaking down into other forms - decaying.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Despite its short lifetime, researchers managed to detect it interacting with other tiny particles at a scale of a billion-trillionth of a metre.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Some theories suggest that at these scales particles are more sensitive to dark matter and it could influence how the quarks interact and break down.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: So, detecting activity in this tiny world could help scientists detect dark matter.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: "We're knocking on the door of this zeptoverse," Dr Harry Cliff, of Cambridge University who led the analysis of the data, told BBC News.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: He said this sub-atomic dance provided researchers with a ringside seat to the behaviour of possible new particles.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: "And what we want to do now is go in and explore and find what new particles are waiting there.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: And to do that, what we need is more data," Cliff added.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Dr Harry Cliff is one of a team of British scientists involved in the research The 28 countries involved in the project have agreed a £150m upgrade to this detector at the Large Hadron Collider (LHCb), which would increase the frequency of these decays tenfold.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: "With that we can probe inside the zeptoverse and see what's waiting," Cliff said.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: But last year the UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) agency, the government body in charge of research funding, announced that it was withdrawing its share of the money for the planned upgrade.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: It later announced cuts to several other particle physics and astronomy projects this Summer, including Jodrell Bank's iconic Lovell telescope .
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Although this research was led by scientists based in Cambridge, because of the cuts, Prof Tim Gershon, who leads the LHCb international collaboration, told BBC News that the UK's full involvement in the research would be in doubt.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: "The UK is at risk of not being involved and making really major discoveries," he told BBC News.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: She is reconsidering her future in light of the physics cuts.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: "I love being here in the UK, but I am looking at jobs abroad because that seems to be where there are more opportunities at the moment," said Richardson-Slipper.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: She added that "lots" of her fellow researchers working in fundamental physics had already moved.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: The cuts are being made despite an overall record increase in the science budget.
sentences.article_title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored

sentences.text: Joao Pedro hasn't played for Chelsea since a win against Everton last month Chelsea have warned staff to be careful about inadvertently revealing team news through Fantasy Premier League after Joao Pedro's injury appeared to have been disclosed through team selections.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: An email was sent to staff reminding them of the potential consequences of using inside information when playing Fantasy Premier League or other public gaming platforms, where team selection choices could reveal which players are unavailable or close to returning.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: It followed leaks before the 2-0 home defeat by Tottenham , when Pedro was a surprise absentee because of what has since emerged to be a quad injury.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Several influential Fantasy Premier League content creators claimed to have seen evidence that forward Morgan Rogers, along with several members of Chelsea staff, had removed Pedro from their Fantasy Premier League teams before kick-off at Stamford Bridge, despite no club announcement having been made about his injury.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Asked about the matter by BBC Sport after the defeat, Xabi Alonso said he was unaware of the situation.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: He replied: "I am not into the fantasy team thing, so I didn't know that." Since joining Chelsea in the summer, Alonso, 44, has generally been guarded when discussing injury issues in media conferences.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Chelsea have also previously experienced problems with leaks.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: During former manager Liam Rosenior's four-month spell in charge last season, team selections were leaked before both legs of the club's Champions League defeat by Paris St-Germain.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: It also later emerged former defender Marc Cucurella's barber had revealed on social media that Pedro and Cole Palmer would miss a trip to Brighton last season after discussing the matter with his client.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: With regard to Fantasy Premier League, no further restrictions are expected because Chelsea regard the incident as an isolated case that can be managed through greater awareness among players and staff.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: The highest-profile example was arguably the revelation of then Aston Villa forward Jack Grealish's omission from the squad before a match against Leicester City in February 2021.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Then Leicester manager Brendan Rodgers later said he had been aware of rumours surrounding Grealish's injury absence before the match, which his side won.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: More than 11 million people are said to play Fantasy Premier League, which has become an increasingly prominent part of the wider football ecosystem.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Although there are strict rules prohibiting gambling, the Premier League offers no specific guidance to clubs on how, or whether, those involved in the game should participate in Fantasy Premier League.
sentences.article_title: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use

sentences.text: Instead, it is generally treated as a matter for individual clubs to manage themselves.

sentences.text: Kettering Town's director of football said the club could no longer hide behind "the comforting lie" that the abuse came from "a small minority" Non-league Kettering Town have said they "can no longer hide" from the issue of racism after a visiting player was allegedly subjected to "sickening" abuse.

sentences.text: Redditch United player Dan Sweeney said he was targeted by a Kettering supporter during Saturday's Southern League Premier Division Central tie at the Poppies' Latimer Park stadium, which the hosts won 2-1.

sentences.text: The incident comes after a match official reported alleged racial abuse at a Kettering fixture last season , and a previous instance of alleged racist abuse against a Redditch player at Latimer Park in 2017 .
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: In a statement, Kettering director of football Fabian Forde said the "poison" of racism went beyond matchdays.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: He also spoke out against the presence of what he called "festering" racism on the club's fans forums.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: Writing on the club's website , external , Forde said: "Let's be completely honest with ourselves: this is not the first time.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: We can no longer hide behind the comforting lie that 'it's just a small minority' or 'they don't reflect the majority of our fans'.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "Every single time we dismiss hate by calling it a minority issue, we minimise the damage.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: The truth is, if the majority stays silent, that small minority becomes our identity.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "They tarnish our reputation in the eyes of opposition players, fans, and officials.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: They make our club look like a haven for bigotry.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: Is that really who we want to be?" Forde added that the club could not "keep sending out generic statements that mean nothing" and urged fans to support "real cultural change" by taking responsibility for calling out the perpetrators of racist abuse.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: He said: "To the majority of our fans, the good, decent people who love this club for the right reasons, we are pleading with you.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "We need you to stand up.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: We need you to confront this minority head-on.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: If you see someone typing hate online, call them out.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: If you hear someone shouting abuse next to you on a Saturday afternoon, don't look away.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: Identify them to the club.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: Should a report be made elsewhere and the alleged offence be found to have taken place within Northamptonshire, we would take ownership of the investigation.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "We note Kettering Town FC's statement that it is working with its security team, stewards and the relevant authorities to identify those responsible, and we would encourage anyone who believes they have been the victim of a crime to report it to police.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "It is vital that this matter is taken seriously and that appropriate action follows.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "Tackling racism requires more than statements.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: It requires leadership, accountability and a collective willingness to challenge unacceptable behaviour whenever and wherever it occurs.
sentences.article_title: Kettering 'cannot hide' from racism problem at club after 'sickening abuse'

sentences.text: "We must never allow incidents like this to become normalised, dismissed or simply forgotten once the immediate attention has passed." The Football Association has also been approached for comment.

sentences.text: Somalia has the longest coastline in mainland Africa As the sun rises over the Indian Ocean, waves lap onto the golden sands while palm fronds rustle in the cool sea breeze.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: This is the image that one young Somali woman wants the world to have of her home city - in contrast to the one of suicide attacks and young men wielding AK-47s that many people currently associate with Somalia's capital.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Sucdi Abdul Fattah Abdul Khader is among a growing number of local guides taking visitors beyond the headlines to explore Mogadishu's beauty spots, historic sites and culture.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Her favourite spot is Jazeera beach, where visitors can enjoy the sea before heading to nearby sand dunes.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "It's one of the tourist attractions where we bring our guests.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: It's a nice place," says the 23-year-old.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: The dunes, she adds, remind some visitors of the Sahara.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: But her tours are about more than scenic views.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She also takes visitors to the fish market, where they discover the variety of marine life available along Somalia's extensive coastline and to parts of the city that reflect its history as a busy Indian Ocean trading centre, with the influences of both its Ottoman and Italian former rulers.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Visitors can also sample Somali food, including camel meat, samosas and traditional tea.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Sucdi says many arrive in the city with expectations shaped by years of hearing about the insecurity.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Mostly, they are surprised by how beautiful the country is and how welcoming people are," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: At the fish market, she says, visitors are particularly impressed by the variety of fish species.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Sucdi Abdul Fattah Abdul Khader wants visitors to experience the "beautiful, welcoming side of Mogadishu" Guiding tours runs in Sucdi's family.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Her father worked in the profession for over three decades, taking journalists, photographers and visitors from different countries around Somalia.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: He introduced her to the business nearly three years ago.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I started this job as a hobby, but it has become something that I like and am passionate about," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She now works alongside her father and a team of guides, building on his experience while using social media to reach a wider audience.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She shares videos of her tours on TikTok, offering people outside Somalia a glimpse of places they may never have imagined visiting.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She is also considering producing content in English to reach audiences who do not speak Somali.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: A wide variety of fish are available in Mogadishu's markets Tourism remains a relatively new field in Somalia, she says, with only a handful working as guides in Mogadishu.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: The business is seasonal, but Sucdi says this year has been particularly encouraging, although numbers are still fairly low.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Having five tourists a week is considered a success but she is confident that numbers will grow.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: However, she says many visitors are still concerned about security.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Since the collapse of Somalia's central government in 1991, Mogadishu has endured decades of civil war, destruction and displacement.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Much of the city centre was reduced to rubble, and basic services and infrastructure largely broke down.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: But following the withdrawal of the Islamist militant group al-Shabab from most of the city in 2011, and the establishment of the federal government in 2012, Mogadishu has undergone a gradual transformation.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Returning members of the Somali diaspora, local entrepreneurs and investors helped fuel a construction boom, with new hotels, restaurants, businesses and residential developments reshaping the capital.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Today, Mogadishu is a growing commercial hub, although insecurity and the legacy of conflict remain part of everyday life.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: About 10,000 tourists visited Somalia in 2024, a 50% increase on the previous year, according to the country's tourism department.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Many visitors ask about their safety before travelling and often encounter security checkpoints around the city.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: But she says their experience on the ground is generally positive.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Lido beach is one of the most popular places for people to relax in Mogadishu "What they heard from the news and everywhere else is not the same as what they see in the country," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Although some question whether Mogadishu is safe enough for a young woman to be working as a tour guide, Sucdi is determined to continue.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She wants visitors to experience a Somalia that is rarely seen.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I would want them to see the beautiful, welcoming side of Mogadishu, and not the side that they heard from the media, which is explosions and bombs," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Somalia has Africa's longest mainland coastline, stretching more than 3,000km (1,860 miles) along the Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Its beaches and sand dunes sit alongside historic coastal cities such as Mogadishu, whose culture reflects centuries of Indian Ocean trade.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Mogadishu is a growing commercial hub For some tourists, that contrast between the country's reputation and what they experience can be striking.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: American travel content creator Chris Reese, who goes by the name Authentic Travelling, has visited Mogadishu twice.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: His first trip, almost a year ago, was a solo visit.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: He enjoyed it so much that he decided to return with a group of friends, who had seen videos of his visit on social media.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I had such a positive experience - I really enjoyed seeing the country for the first time - that I opted to bring back a group of my friends," he says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: What stands out for Chris is the city's coastal setting, its food and atmosphere.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "It is such a beautiful tropical place.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I love the vibe, the weather and the food," he says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: The sand dunes near Mogadishu remind some visitors of the Sahara Desert During the group's visit, they enjoy lunch overlooking the Indian Ocean before heading out to explore the beaches and sand dunes.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "The desert is beautiful and picturesque.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: It is also amazing that it's barely a 30-minute drive from Mogadishu," he says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Before his first trip, Chris says, much of what he knew about Somalia came from international news coverage.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "If you only read the news reports about Somalia, you would be scared to visit.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: And honestly, that's what I saw in the media before I came, mostly negative headlines." But visiting the country challenged those perceptions.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Coming here, on my very first trip, showed me that there is so much more to this country than what is shown in the headlines," he says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Romanian Mihaela Patap says she prefers to visit new countries without preconceived ideas Mihaela Patap, from Romania, loves Somalia's natural beauty.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Although she has spent only a few hours in Mogadishu, she has already visited the sand dunes and taken in the Indian Ocean coastline.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "The desert was so beautiful to see.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I have also enjoyed the beach, and the ocean.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: It is inspiring," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Having travelled to Somalia from neighbouring Ethiopia, she says she has been struck by the people's friendliness.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I don't see anything dangerous.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I feel safe and the people are warm," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: An experienced traveller, Mihaela says she prefers to visit new countries without having preconceived ideas.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I travel the world to see new places, to see countries, to see the differences.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I don't take a picture in my mind to compare the reality with.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I'm just expecting the new to come to me," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She hopes to share her experience and encourage others to visit Somalia.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I'm going to post my pictures and say good things about what I'm experiencing.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I'm going to promote it," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: For Sucdi, that potential is personal.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She is continuing a family profession while building a business in an industry with few women and using digital platforms to reach audiences far beyond Mogadishu.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Somalia still has a long way to go before tourism becomes a major industry," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: It was an unlikely greeting to hear at a Democratic Party victory rally after the US midterm elections.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Abdul El-Sayed , 42, born to Egyptian immigrant parents, playfully addressed Vice-President JD Vance, who had campaigned against him but will now swear him into office in January as Michigan's new Senator.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The US-born Democrat spent much of his campaign fending off attacks from conservative media and President Donald Trump, who accused him of supporting the Muslim Brotherhood.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: El-Sayed rejected the allegations.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: "My name is Abdul Rahman Mohammed El-Sayed," he said in an Egyptian Arabic accent to the cheering crowd at his victory rally.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His Arabic Muslim name was a target for many of his opponents.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He is set to become the first Muslim senator.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: El-Sayed ran a social media-first campaign, with TikTok edits showing him speaking directly to young voters, tapping into Gen Z humour, and sporting friendship bracelets.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The former public health administrator's campaign centred on a progressive agenda, including Medicare for All, affordable housing and curbing corporate influence in politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He has also been a vocal critic of US military aid to Israel.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: But El-Sayed was not alone.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: From an Ethiopian-born Gen Z congresswoman to candidates with Nigerian heritage, several other politicians with African roots won in this year's midterms.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The elections, held halfway through a president's four-year term, decide who represents Americans in Congress, as well as in thousands of state and local offices.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Born in Addis Ababa, Melat Kiros' family moved to Denver when she was a baby At 29, Melat Kiros became the first Gen Z woman elected to the US Congress.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Born in Ethiopia, she arrived in the US as a baby and grew up in Denver.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She had never held elected office before defeating a 15-term incumbent in Colorado's 1st District in the Democrat primary before winning a landslide in Tuesday's election.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros, like El-Sayed, campaigned on issues that have become central to young progressive voters: the cost of living, universal childcare and Medicare for All.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Endorsed by the Democratic Socialists of America, she has also called for abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement and ending US military aid to Israel.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Her outspoken criticism of Israel's war in Gaza has attracted controversy.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros has said her criticism is directed at the Israeli state, not Jewish people.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She was fired from a top New York law firm in 2023 after she refused to take down an open letter to dozens of law firms who had urged law school deans to crack down on antisemitism on campuses as students engaged in pro-Palestinian protests.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros condemned antisemitism, but warned the law firms, including the one she worked for, against conflating "such bigotry with the geo-political question of Israel's legitimacy".
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She said she started thinking more seriously about politics in general after being fired.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Adrian Boafo's parents moved from Ghana to the US Adrian Boafo, meanwhile, a second-generation Ghanaian-American, will represent Maryland's 5th Congressional District after succeeding veteran Congressman Steny Hoyer, who retired after a political career spanning more than four decades.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The 32-year-old was born in Virginia and raised in Prince George's County, Maryland.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His parents immigrated to the US from Ghana.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Boafo's route to Congress began in local politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He served on the Bowie City Council before becoming a Maryland state delegate in 2023.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He also worked for Hoyer before eventually winning the race to replace him.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His campaign focused on the cost of living, childcare and protecting federal workers, a major issue in a district close to Washington DC and home to thousands of government employees.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: In his victory statement, Boafo said representing his constituents had "never felt more urgent", pointing to federal job cuts, rising costs and the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Among those returning to Congress is Somali-born Ilhan Omar, 44, who won a fifth term despite an ongoing federal investigation.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Federal agents searched her Washington home in October as part of an investigation into her immigration paperwork.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Omar has denied wrongdoing and has not been charged with a crime.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: First elected to Congress in 2018, Omar became the first Somali-American and one of the first Muslim women to serve in the chamber.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She has also been a frequent target of President Trump, who has repeatedly criticised her and other Somali immigrants.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Trump has previously used derogatory language to describe some African countries, including Somalia.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: In October, his Yemeni-born adviser Amer Ghalib said the president would refrain from using such language.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Others made their breakthroughs in state and local politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Junior Ezeonu was born in Nigeria and moved to the US as a young child.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: By 27, he had already become Grand Prairie's youngest city council member before winning a seat in the Texas State House.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Then there is Carol Kazeem , 34, a Pennsylvania state legislator of Nigerian heritage who has retained her seat at District 159.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: At least four candidates with Nigerian heritage won in the 3 November midterms.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: For some young Africans watching from across the Atlantic, these victories have offered a glimpse of what a new generation of voters could achieve at home.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: On social media, users have shared the election results as a source of inspiration, particularly in Nigeria and Kenya, where major elections are due in 2027.

sentences.text: In April, Rukayat Taiwo Suleimon became the first female blind sambist in the world to win a gold medal at a major international tournament Rukayat Taiwo Suleimon only took up sambo this year, but the Nigerian has already secured her place in the history of the martial art.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: The sport shares strong roots with judo and wrestling, combining techniques such as hip and leg throws to take opponents to the mat, where they can be pinned.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Originally developed by the Soviet Union's Red Army in the 1920s, it was officially recognised as a combat sport by USSR officials in 1938.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Competing at the 2026 World Sambo Cup in Armenia, Suleimon defeated Uzbekistan's Charos Ortikova in the final of the women's 54kg category to claim victory on her international debut.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: It was the first time that women with visual impairments had been included at the competition.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "Being the first female blind sambist in the world to win the gold medal makes me great," the 32-year-old told BBC Sport Africa.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "This is my first time in sambo and God crowned my efforts." Suleimon's achievement was part of a breakthrough moment for African women in the sport.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: She and compatriot Elizabeth Aseso, who competed in the 59kg category, were among the pioneering sambists representing the continent in Yerevan.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: For Suleimon, her gold medal is a reward for the hard work over many years which has seen her move from athletics to judo and now to the top of the international sambo podium.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I really benefit a lot from sports and, despite my blindness, I achieve a lot," she said.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "If I [were] not blind, I don't think I would be at this level.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: I believe I will achieve even more." Suleimon is set to compete at the World Sambo Championships in Uzbekistan in November Suleimon's journey to becoming a champion has been marked by hardship and a determination to rebuild her life.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: After failed surgeries she lost her sight in 2009 because of glaucoma, an eye condition that damages the optic nerve and can lead to permanent loss of vision.

sentences.text: Morocco claims Western Sahara as part of its territory Morocco has welcomed the end of a decades-long UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara, after a diplomatic showdown between the US and Russia left the Security Council unable to agree on its future.

sentences.text: The Confederation of African Football (Caf) will instead retain the tournament's traditional biennial staging, with its president Patrice Motsepe saying the U-turn was based on "advancing, protecting and promoting" the interests of the African game.

sentences.text: Afcon has predominantly been held every two years since its first edition in 1957, barring two three-year gaps in the 1960s and one year between the 2012 and 2013 tournaments.

sentences.text: In recent years Afcon has been staged midway through the European club season, leading to recurring disputes over the release of African players.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Fifa general secretary Mattias Grafstrom was sitting aside Motsepe when the plan was announced, and critics highlighted that the scheduling change favoured football's world governing body more than the African game.

sentences.text: "I think the general sentiment around the continent has been that the two-year cycle has served the continent very well," Football Association of Zambia (Faz) official Sydney Mungala told the BBC.

sentences.text: In its stead, an annual Africa Nations League involving all 54 countries on the continent was proposed.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Motsepe described the ambition as creating a "world-class competition every year".
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The idea was to move beyond Caf's heavy reliance on Afcon and develop a more sustainable commercial model which could support football development.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Yet the last time an ambitious alternative competition took place in Africa, it failed to deliver on its financial promise and was quickly ditched.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The Africa Super League, announced by Caf in 2022 to revolutionise continental club competition, and with projected annual revenues of $200m (£149m), was discontinued after just one edition.

sentences.text: Yiech Pur Biel (left) is leading the first ever refugee team at the Youth Olympics When he started running, Yiech Pur Biel had to compete barefoot.

sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: In 2016, Biel made history competing in the 800m event as part of the first Olympic refugee team at the Rio summer Olympics in Brazil.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics
